_readme: Edit this file, then run `npm run invite:gala`. Images land in output/gala-invitation/. See README.md in this folder.
_trips: The 8 Gala trips, copied from Branding/Gala/WorldOfConnections/trips/trips.json (board decision 2026-11-09). Keep them in step with it. `price` is the PUBLIC price only, shown just when showPrices is true; never copy trips.json's internal listPrice here. `photo` is the trip's hero still (01) from trips/<id>/pack/stills/, copied into assets/trips/ at 1600 px; photoAlt, photoPlace, photoCredit and photoSource come from that folder's stills.json. CC BY / BY-SA photos must show photoCredit, which the card prints on the photo (photo null = text-only card).

trips.name: Greece
trips.title: Greece & the Greek Islands
trips.summary: Three nights in Santorini, three in Mykonos, then two in Athens beneath the Acropolis, linked by an island flight and a ferry.
trips.photoAlt: Blue-domed white churches of Oia above the Santorini caldera and the Aegean Sea
trips.photoCredit: Giles Laurent / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

trips.name: Iceland
trips.title: Iceland: Land of the Vikings
trips.summary: Six nights in Reykjavík with a food tour, the geysers and waterfalls of the Golden Circle, and the Sky Lagoon spa ritual.
trips.photoAlt: Gullfoss waterfall plunging into its canyon with a rainbow in the spray
trips.photoCredit: Diego Delso / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

trips.name: Cortona
trips.title: Cortona: Under the Tuscan Sun for four
trips.summary: Six nights in a two-bedroom suite in the old town of Cortona, the hilltop village made famous by Under the Tuscan Sun.
trips.photoAlt: The walled hilltop town of Cortona among olive terraces, seen from the air
trips.photoCredit: TeKappa / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

trips.name: Scotland
trips.title: Scotland: Lochs & Legends
trips.summary: Edinburgh's castle and Royal Mile, a Loch Ness cruise, then Glasgow and the West Highlands to Glencoe and Loch Lomond.
trips.photoAlt: Golden evening light on the mountains of Glencoe in the Scottish Highlands
trips.photoCredit: john mcsporran from Trossachs, Scotland / CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

trips.name: South Africa
trips.title: South Africa: Wild Wonders Photo Safari
trips.summary: Five nights in a lakefront tented camp with a private plunge pool, guided game drives every day, and a Big Five drive.
trips.photoAlt: A young male lion resting in the long grass, looking toward the camera
trips.photoCredit: Chris Eason / CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
trips._photoPlace: Left blank on purpose: the hero still is from Kruger National Park, but the trip's safari camp location isn't confirmed, so the card doesn't name a place.

trips.name: Portugal
trips.title: Captivating Portugal: Lisbon & Porto
trips.summary: Lisbon and Sintra, a private guided drive north to Porto, and a Douro Valley day of wine, lunch and a river cruise.
trips.photoAlt: Traditional rabelo boats on the Douro in front of Porto's Ribeira waterfront at golden hour
trips.photoCredit: Krzysztof Golik / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

trips.name: Costa Rica
trips.title: Colorful Costa Rica
trips.summary: Rainforest and volcano around Arenal, then the Pacific beaches of Tamarindo, with two tours of the traveler's choosing.
trips.photoAlt: The cone of Arenal Volcano rising above green rainforest and farmland
trips.photoCredit: Rhododendrites / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

trips.name: Alaska
trips.title: Alaska Cruise: Explorer of the North
trips.summary: A cruise from Seattle in a balcony cabin, calling at Ketchikan, Juneau, Skagway and Victoria, British Columbia.
trips.photoAlt: Mendenhall Glacier flowing between mountains into its lake near Juneau
trips.photoCredit: Jay Galvin (jay galvin) / CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
